tasks.title: Hosted Bench passes with R-derived temporary notify test CPU limits
tasks.spec: ## Repository: api — Behavior, Checks and Completion evidence; Required behavior 1-9; Acceptance evidence (Provenance and checks 1-6); Security impact; Rollout order. Follow R before edits, then the two-file change, V and PR; M follows a person's merge and completes the feature, not the child build.

acceptance.command: git ls-remote --tags --sort=-v:refname https://github.com/lorenzh/pulse-notify.git 'v*' && gh api repos/lorenzh/pulse-notify/git/ref/tags/v0.1.0 && gh api "repos/lorenzh/pulse-notify/compare/757e78f27cfdbb89109c216dcba829158ea7b5c3...$NOTIFY_PRE" --jq .status
acceptance.expected: Before R and again before V, newest notify v* tag is v0.1.0, its object.type is commit and object.sha is c090a07811590eb158849fb9981f3c94fec74276, and notify main's PRE SHA contains 757e78f27cfdbb89109c216dcba829158ea7b5c3 (compare status ahead or identical). Apply the containment check to M too. A newer tag requires needs-input naming that tag; do not calibrate against a release that already contains the ledger. Any containment status other than ahead or identical requires an immediate hold; containment does not establish which main SHA was measured.

acceptance.command: gh run list -R lorenzh/pulse-api --workflow bench.yml --branch main --json databaseId,createdAt,conclusion,url
acceptance.expected: Inspect applicable nightly Bench tables until this change lands: only notify.test_cpu_s may have verdict FAIL regression or FAIL budget. Any other failing row requires needs-input with its run link and row; change no unrelated value or code.

acceptance.command: git ls-remote "https://github.com/lorenzh/pulse-$repo.git" refs/heads/main && git ls-remote --tags --sort=-v:refname "https://github.com/lorenzh/pulse-$repo.git" 'v*' && git ls-remote --tags "https://github.com/lorenzh/pulse-$repo.git" "refs/tags/$TAG" "refs/tags/$TAG^{}"
acceptance.expected: For each of R, V and post-merge M, apply Acceptance evidence / Provenance to api, probe, status, notify, contract, kit and config. Record PRE main SHAs and newest v* tags with resolved tag commits immediately before dispatch, and POST readings immediately after completion. Pin api B to its just-read full main SHA for R/V; include api main in M's unpinned B checks. Resolve annotated tags using the peeled SHA when present, otherwise the lightweight tag SHA. For every A side, the tag named in the run log must be newest at both readings and its commit must be unchanged; notify A must be v0.1.0 at c090a07811590eb158849fb9981f3c94fec74276. Tag movement or inability to identify a measured SHA discards the run, permits one fresh dispatch with new snapshots, then requires needs-input with both links and PRE/POST evidence.

acceptance.command: gh api "repos/lorenzh/pulse-$repo/activity?ref=refs/heads/main&per_page=100" && gh run view "$RUN" -R lorenzh/pulse-api --log && gh run view "$RUN" -R lorenzh/pulse-api --json headSha,url
acceptance.expected: For every unpinned B main in R/V/M, identify the measured SHA as PRE only if POST == PRE, or the activity list covers the interval and proves every push after PRE was read occurred after the timestamped [bench] cold-read seed (b) log line, which follows all B checkouts. In the latter case the first push must have before == PRE and a timestamp strictly later than that log line; preserve the push before/after/timestamp and log timestamp. PRE-to-POST ancestry alone is never evidence of the measured commit. If neither rule holds for any repository, discard and dispatch once more with fresh PRE, then hold with both links and PRE/POST values. The A/B log refs must agree with the recorded refs, including pinned api B for R/V. Record headSha separately as the harness/budgets checkout: unchanged branch for R, edited commit for V, merge commit or later main for M. Symbolic refs and headSha alone do not prove measured worktree SHAs.

acceptance.command: API_B=$(git ls-remote https://github.com/lorenzh/pulse-api.git refs/heads/main | cut -f1); gh workflow run bench.yml -R lorenzh/pulse-api --ref "$BRANCH" -f "b=$API_B"
acceptance.expected: R is dispatched on the unchanged api implementation branch before any file edit, with b pinned to the just-read full api main SHA and a and others omitted. The unchanged harness runs its default five alternating A/B rounds. Record R's ID/link and pre-edit workflow SHA. Do not dispatch on main with b set to the implementation branch, pin others, change the workflow, or select new samples after a gating failure.

acceptance.command: gh run view "$R" -R lorenzh/pulse-api --log && gh run download "$R" -R lorenzh/pulse-api --name bench-out --dir /tmp/pulse-652-R
acceptance.expected: R reached the table with samples.json, table.json and table.md; every present sample list has five values, including five unrounded samples each at samples.a.notify.test_cpu_s and samples.b.notify.test_cpu_s. Harness exit is 0 or 1 (bench/run.ts:263,272), never 2 (bench/run.ts:273-275). No table row other than notify/test_cpu_s has verdict FAIL regression or FAIL budget. A missing/incomplete artifact, 90-minute job timeout or harness error permits one more dispatch, then needs-input with both run links; another failing row requires an immediate hold. Provenance must also pass. Record the ten samples, medians (3rd smallest), other-row results and exit code.

acceptance.command: bun -e 'import assert from "node:assert/strict"; const r = await Bun.file("/tmp/pulse-652-R/samples.json").json(); const a = [...r.samples.a.notify.test_cpu_s].sort((x,y) => x-y); const b = [...r.samples.b.notify.test_cpu_s].sort((x,y) => x-y); assert.equal(a.length,5); assert.equal(b.length,5); const A = a[2], B = b[2]; const A_us = BigInt(Math.round(A*1e6)), B_us = BigInt(Math.round(B*1e6)); console.log(JSON.stringify({a,b,A,B,A_us,B_us},(_,v) => typeof v === "bigint" ? v.toString() : v)); assert.ok(B_us-A_us >= 200000n); const cd = (n,d) => (n+d-1n)/d; const floor_tenths = cd(B_us-A_us+200000n,100000n); const p_tenths = cd(13n*A_us,1000000n); const q_tenths = cd(B_us+100000n,100000n); const budget_tenths = p_tenths > q_tenths ? p_tenths : q_tenths; console.log(JSON.stringify({floor_tenths,p_tenths,q_tenths,budget_tenths,floor:Number(floor_tenths)/10,budget:Number(budget_tenths)/10},(_,v) => typeof v === "bigint" ? v.toString() : v)); assert.ok(floor_tenths <= 14n); assert.ok(budget_tenths <= 32n);'
acceptance.expected: Before editing, derive both values from R's unrounded third-of-five medians. Only raw A/B become integer microseconds; all ceilings use BigInt ceilDiv, preserving fractional microseconds in A*1.3. Exit 0 requires B_us-A_us >= 200000, floor_tenths <= 14 and budget_tenths <= 32. No composite expression is rounded to microseconds, and no floating-point ceiling is used. A failed bound requires needs-input with ten samples, medians, arithmetic, R's link and SHAs; never clamp, guess, widen caps or average across runs. Reference counterexamples in the spec must yield floor 1.4 for A=1.88/B=3.08, q 2.8 for B=2.7, and p 2.6 for A=1.923077.

acceptance.command: bun -e 'import assert from "node:assert/strict"; const r = await Bun.file("/tmp/pulse-652-R/samples.json").json(); const a = [...r.samples.a.notify.test_cpu_s].sort((x,y) => x-y); const b = [...r.samples.b.notify.test_cpu_s].sort((x,y) => x-y); assert.equal(a.length,5); assert.equal(b.length,5); const A_us = BigInt(Math.round(a[2]*1e6)), B_us = BigInt(Math.round(b[2]*1e6)); assert.ok(B_us-A_us >= 200000n); const cd = (n,d) => (n+d-1n)/d; const f = cd(B_us-A_us+200000n,100000n), p = cd(13n*A_us,1000000n), q = cd(B_us+100000n,100000n), budget = p > q ? p : q; assert.ok(f <= 14n); assert.ok(budget <= 32n); const edited = (await Bun.file("bench/budgets.json").json()).notify.test_cpu_s; assert.equal(edited.floor,Number(f)/10); assert.equal(edited.budget,Number(budget)/10);'
acceptance.expected: After the two-file edit, independent recomputation from R's original artifact exits 0 and matches both edited numbers exactly. Expected values come from R, never from the edited file. The PR writes A_us/B_us and each integer numerator, denominator and result for floor_tenths, p_tenths, q_tenths and budget_tenths, with caps 14/32 tenths (1.4/3.2 s). V and M never re-derive the values.

acceptance.command: git diff --stat origin/main && git diff -U0 origin/main -- bench/budgets.json && grep -c thresholdPct bench/budgets.json
acceptance.expected: The diff contains exactly bench/budgets.json and bench/README.md. The JSON diff changes exactly the notify.test_cpu_s budget and floor number lines, from 2.5 and 0.6 to the independently R-derived values. Every other byte, including key order, unit s, gating true, other notify metrics and all other service values, is unchanged. grep prints 0 (its no-match exit status is 1). No baseline, harness, self-test, workflow, dependency, code or tag changes.

Only the notify-related introduction and notify bullet within Temporary test floors change. The introduction attributes api/status to R1 and notify to R, retaining R1's link. Notify's bullet links R, identifies A v0.1.0/c090a07 and B main's recorded SHA containing #41/757e78f, gives both medians to three decimals, links the accepted #649 owner decision (https://github.com/lorenzh/pulse-meta/issues/649#issuecomment-6594413459), and writes both formulas with numeric substitutions, intermediate results, final values and caps 1.4/3.2. Both values are explicitly temporary. Api/status bullets and the closing release rule remain byte-for-byte unchanged: the first api PR after the next notify v* tag removes its floor and resets its budget to ceil0.1(new A*1.3). No release tag is created.
Exit 0 with the repository's existing lint, typecheck and full test/coverage gates on Bun 1.4.0; do not weaken configuration or format unrelated files.
Exit 0; all eight existing bench self-tests pass, including check-budgets parsing the edited budget data and checking every emitted metric.
Exit 0. Hosted R and V exercise the existing compose-based Bench stack end to end; no new compose or test files are needed.

acceptance.command: API_B=$(git ls-remote https://github.com/lorenzh/pulse-api.git refs/heads/main | cut -f1); gh workflow run bench.yml -R lorenzh/pulse-api --ref "$BRANCH" -f "b=$API_B"
acceptance.expected: After committing the two-file edit and repeating the tag precondition and Provenance snapshots, dispatch V from the branch checkout containing that commit, with fresh pinned api B and a/others omitted. V uses the new budgets, is complete under R's completeness checks, passes the same exact-SHA Provenance rules, and exits 0 with no failing row. Record V's link, artifact, notify medians and SHAs. An incomplete run, including unprovable measured SHAs or a harness error, permits one fresh dispatch, then hold; a gating failure requires needs-input immediately, with R/V samples and the failing row, and never widening or repeated attempts until green. V never re-derives the values.

PR body names the issue and check results; includes R's run/artifact links, ten unrounded notify samples, medians, exit code, both values' BigInt arithmetic/caps, workflow SHA, and exact A/B SHAs for all seven repositories. Include PRE/POST per repository, unchanged tag commits/newest-tag readings and, for differing main refs, the activity push before/after/timestamps and cold-read seed (b) log timestamp that prove PRE was measured. Notify B contains 757e78f27cfdbb89109c216dcba829158ea7b5c3, notify A is c090a07811590eb158849fb9981f3c94fec74276, and no other row fails. Include V's link, exit 0, notify medians and SHAs with the same Provenance rules. Security impact is no, verified by the two-file data/documentation scope; no routes, parsers, clients, writes, logs, dependencies, Dockerfiles or CI change. State that the child build completes with V while feature acceptance awaits M on api main after a person's merge, whose evidence must be added as a PR comment. On a hold report all samples, medians, arithmetic, run links and SHAs gathered so far.

acceptance.command: gh workflow run bench.yml -R lorenzh/pulse-api --ref main
acceptance.expected: Post-merge feature acceptance only: record fresh PRE main/tag readings for all seven repositories before dispatching M with default inputs. After completion record POST and apply the same exact-SHA Provenance rules, including api main. A 02:17 UTC nightly counts instead only when activity data for every repository proves which main SHA was current at run start and no push preceded the [bench] cold-read seed (b) timestamp; otherwise dispatch M. An incomplete run or unprovable SHA permits one fresh dispatch, then hold. A gating failure holds with M's samples; do not re-run until green. No merge or tag is part of this task; the child build completes with V.

acceptance.command: gh run view "$M" -R lorenzh/pulse-api --log && gh run view "$M" -R lorenzh/pulse-api --json headSha,headBranch,conclusion,url && gh run download "$M" -R lorenzh/pulse-api --name bench-out --dir /tmp/pulse-652-M && gh pr view "$PR" -R lorenzh/pulse-api --json comments,url
acceptance.expected: After a person's merge, M is complete under R's artifact/five-sample checks, exits 0 with no failing row, and its workflow checkout is api main at the merge commit or a descendant containing it. Record M's link, notify A/B medians and exact SHAs with Provenance evidence in a comment on the implementation PR. This completes feature acceptance. Do not claim M has passed during the pre-merge child build.
